scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:rust && pnpm test && pnpm coverage && pnpm build && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:entrypoints && pnpm demo:headless && pnpm check:genericity && pnpm release:smoke
scripts.check:security: node scripts/check-native-capabilities.mjs && node scripts/check-licenses.mjs && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs
scripts.demo:headless: node apps/headless/dist/cli.js && node apps/headless/dist/persistence-cli.js && node apps/headless/dist/recovery-cli.js
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs .dependency-cruiser.cjs scripts && turbo run lint
scripts.coverage: pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/math test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/model test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/shared test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/voxel test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/document test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/commands test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/formats test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/storage test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/session test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/interchange test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/renderer test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/agent test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/editor test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/testkit test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/evaluation test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/headless test:coverage && pnpm --filter @voxel-maker/benchmarks test:coverage
scripts.bench:smoke: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter @voxel-maker/bench-cli... && node --expose-gc apps/bench-cli/dist/cli.js --tier ci-smoke --sizes 100000 --kinds compact,checkerboard --samples 30 --save-load-runs 3 --preview-samples 4 --preview-size 128 --animation-frames 20 --json benchmarks/out/smoke.json --no-progress
scripts.bench:full: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter @voxel-maker/bench-cli... && node --expose-gc apps/bench-cli/dist/cli.js --tier auto --full --samples 100 --save-load-runs 5 --preview-samples 8 --animation-frames 100 --json benchmarks/out/full.json --trends benchmarks/trends.json --no-progress
scripts.bench:local: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter @voxel-maker/bench-cli... && node --expose-gc apps/bench-cli/dist/cli.js --tier ci-smoke --sizes 100000,500000 --kinds compact,sparse,checkerboard --samples 40 --save-load-runs 3 --preview-samples 4 --animation-frames 30 --json benchmarks/out/local.json --no-progress
